patthana21.5:1.1: na appaccayaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā sappaccayo kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā ekaṃ.

patthana21.5:8.1: na sappaṭighaṃ nakusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā appaṭigho kusalo …pe…
